name: starflask_generate_image
description: Create a Starflask text-to-image (or image-edit) generation job. Returns immediately with a job id ({"data":{"id":"<uuid>"}}) — the job runs asynchronously, so poll it with starflask_get_job until status is 'completed', then read result.image_url (a downloadable presigned URL). Pass the generation request as the `payload` object. Simplest form: {"prompt": "a tiny red fox on a mushroom"}. To pick a model, set aspect ratio, or edit an existing image, use the structured form: {"structured_data": {"model_key": "gpt-image-2", "params": {"prompt": "...", "aspect_ratio": "16:9"}}}. Optional top-level "image_style_key" (see starflask_list_styles) applies a style; if omitted the server uses the default style. Discover model keys and their input_schema with starflask_list_models — common image models: ideogram-v3 (default, great typography), gpt-image-2 / gpt-image-2-hi, nano-banana / nano-banana-edit (editing). For image edits, first upload the source with starflask_upload_media and pass its url inside params.

payload.description: The image generation request. Either {"prompt": "..."} for a quick default-model image, or {"structured_data": {"model_key": "<key>", "params": {"prompt": "...", "aspect_ratio": "16:9"}}} to choose a model and parameters. May include an optional top-level "image_style_key".
